description: Creates a demographic-banded reference range (gender + age band + pregnancy flag + effective date range) for a parameter.

body.gender: enum, optional, default ANY - MALE | FEMALE | ANY
body.ageUnit: enum, optional, default YEARS - DAYS | MONTHS | YEARS

validation: parameterId must reference an existing parameter_master row (NOT NULL FK)
effectiveTo, if provided, must be >= effectiveFrom (CHECK chk_reference_range_master_effective)
referenceMax, if provided along with referenceMin, must be >= referenceMin (CHECK chk_reference_range_master_bounds)
must not overlap an existing active band for the same parameterId + gender + ageUnit + pregnancyFlag across age range and effective-date range (DB trigger trg_prevent_reference_range_overlap)

errors.condition: parameterId does not reference an existing parameter
a new/updated band overlaps an existing active band for the same demographic scope and effective-date range

constraints: chk_reference_range_master_effective CHECK (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from)
chk_reference_range_master_bounds CHECK (reference_max IS NULL OR reference_min IS NULL OR reference_max >= reference_min)
uq_reference_range_master UNIQUE (organization_id, branch_id, parameter_id, gender, age_min, age_max, pregnancy_flag, effective_from)
trg_prevent_reference_range_overlap BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger rejects overlapping active bands

notes: Unlike the quantity/transaction-reference DB gaps found in other modules, the overlap-protection error here (API-116) is a genuinely DB-enforced rule: database/schema/031_reference_range_master.sql defines a BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger (trg_prevent_reference_range_overlap / prevent_reference_range_overlap()) that raises an exception containing 'overlapping demographic band' when a new active band's age range and effective-date range intersect an existing active band for the same parameter_id + gender + age_unit + pregnancy_flag. database/e2e-validation/015_reference_range_master.sql's MD021 DO block confirms this by asserting the INSERT fails with that exact message. The age/effective/bounds CHECK constraints (API-117/118/119) are also genuinely DB-enforced, not gaps.
